$comment: The case index. Every case names its clause (clauses.json), its polarity (positive: a conforming implementation accepts; negative: it rejects or flags), its kind (the adapter command: parse | roundtrip | check), the corpus path, and the expectation. Paths are relative to this file's directory. The optional 'with' map names the package locator for composition cases, again relative to this directory. Expectation fields per kind: parse -> parse: ok|error, errorMatch (required when error), issues (exact code set, optional); roundtrip -> roundtrip: ok|error, outputEqualsInput / outputDiffersFromInput (optional); check -> clean: true, rules (exact error-severity rule id set), or error (the evaluation itself must fail with a matching message).

The bind path is canonical on the field line — `bind model.parameters.e_max` serializes to itself byte-for-byte, never dropped.
A limit's quantity typing (v3.2, clause 11.1.2) re-serializes to a fixed point.
The quantity unit is canonical quoted — `unit "counts/v"` serializes to itself byte-for-byte, the string-facet spelling every other unit site (the verdict quantity, clause 11.3) already emits.

A note carrying clause-site provenance serializes canonically: the `source { doc clause }` facet folds to `ref derives-from "urn:…#clause-N"` and back byte-for-byte.
